name: Residence Permit for Studies/Training

requirements.blocker_text: Requires enrollment at an educational institution; initial permit is issued for up to 1 year, extendable annually until studies are completed.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to an Albanian educational institution.

requirements.blocker_text: A Type D visa is normally required to enter and then apply for the residence permit in-country.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Type D visa via e-visa.al or an Albanian consulate.

evidence_required.document: Admission letter from an educational institution

outcome.duration_length: Up to 1 year initially, extendable annually until completion of studies

sources.title: Ministria e Brendshme (Ministry of Interior) -- Residence and Unified Permits: Education & Training category, up to 1 year initial, extendable annually; also covers unpaid trainees, au pairs (age 18-30), scientific research, youth exchanges
Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs of Albania -- Type D visa for stays exceeding 90 days

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Albania). No fee/tuition threshold or financial-solvency figure was specified on the source page for students specifically (unlike several other countries in this dataset) -- not modeled as a hard requirement since none was stated. Fee exemption confirmed for a specific subgroup: Kosovo citizens and ethnic Albanians from regional countries studying in Albania pay only the biometric document fee, a real and notable carve-out worth flagging but not modeled as a separate route given it only affects cost, not eligibility. Source also covers adjacent short-stay categories not modeled as separate files here: unpaid trainees (max 1 year), au pairs (ages 18-30, 1 year + one 6-month renewal), scientific researchers and youth exchange participants (up to 1 year each) -- all structurally similar enough to be folded into this file's scope rather than split into five near-duplicate routes.
